name: Deep Fantasy
source:
Island Seasus stays with the southern part cursed and northern part shredded by the dragon. 
Southern part grew and developed while north drowned in conflict and ruin. Rulers of the South searched for a maiden to lift the curse and managed to take two royal blood princesses captive during the first war. But the ritual is going to fail unless princesses cooperate, and to ensure that main character is giving them sexual training.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-september-2001-eve-fatal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
塞萨斯岛南部受到诅咒，北部则遭巨龙摧毁。
南部不断成长发展，北部却深陷冲突与毁灭。南方统治者为了寻找解除诅咒的少女，在第一次战争中成功俘虏了两名拥有王族血统的公主。然而，如果公主们拒绝配合，仪式便会失败。为了确保她们服从，主人公正在对二人实施性调教。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-september-2001-eve-fatal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
